record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210>.<Fo><Fo> O sing<WH07891><WTH8798> unto the LORD<WH03068> a new<WH02319> song<WH07892>; for he hath done<WH06213><WTH8804> marvellous things<WH06381><WTH8737>: his right hand<WH03225>, and his holy<WH06944> arm<WH02220>, hath gotten him the victory<WH03467><WTH8689>.

Before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068>; for he cometh<WH0935><WTH8804> to judge<WH08199><WTH8800> the earth<WH0776>: with righteousness<WH06664> shall he judge<WH08199><WTH8799> the world<WH08398>, and the people<WH05971> with equity<WH04339>.<CM>
